transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. Chat. What brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. Chat. Well, I guess I'm here because things have been pretty tense at home lately. It's mostly about my wife. 

I know she says her late meetings and these little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... well, for the past year, they’ve lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It really seems like there’s a private signal in them, like it's meant to tell me something she just won’t say directly. She thinks I'm reading into it and wanted me to talk to someone, so here I am.
Have you noticed hearing or seeing things that other people around you don’t?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. 

It's really just... what's right in front of me, you know? The texts, the emails, the times she actually gets home. I'm just reading what's already written down, not imagining floating words or hearing whispers or anything. My hearing and vision are perfectly fine.
Have you started any new medications, drugs, or supplements around the time these beliefs began?

No, no new medications. I don't really take much of anything, to be honest. Um, maybe an ibuprofen now and then if my neck gets stiff from grading papers, but that's about it. I haven't started any new prescriptions or vitamins or supplements, and I definitely don't use any other kinds of drugs. So, no, nothing like that has changed.
Have these beliefs caused any problems with your work, relationships, or daily life?

No, not with work or my normal routine. I mean, I still show up for all my teaching sections, and I'm keeping up with my data analysis just fine. My day-to-day hasn't really changed—I still ride my bike, I still meet up with my friends to play chess... all of that is completely normal. 

The main place this actually causes trouble is really just at home. My wife and I just get stuck arguing about what her work schedule really means, and that gets pretty exhausting for both of us. But outside of that specific issue with her, no, everything else is fine.
